title: Buckley Carlson CORNERS Will Chamberlain Over Massie's Defeat
description:
In this heated panel debate from Piers Morgan Uncensored, four commentators go head to head over the real reasons behind Thomas Massie's historic primary defeat in Kentucky. Glenn Greenwald, Buckley Carlson, Will Chamberlain, and Clay Travis each bring sharply different perspectives on what actually happened and what it means for the future of American politics.

Thomas Massie served in Congress for over 12 years and was known for his consistent positions on government spending, foreign policy restraint, privacy rights, and opposition to costly military interventions abroad. He voted with his party more than 90 percent of the time, yet found himself targeted in the most expensive primary race in United States history, with over 15 million dollars spent against him by powerful lobbying groups and billionaire donors.

The central question driving this debate is whether Massie lost because of genuine policy disagreements over the Big Beautiful Bill, which contained much of the current administration's domestic agenda, or whether the real motivation was his increasingly vocal criticism of foreign policy and the influence of wealthy donor networks in American elections.
